dimensions.name: Knowledge Delta
dimensions.justification: Provides many specific, up‑to‑date details (widget caps, exact role name CloudWatch-CrossAccountSharingRole, cost of custom metrics, EMF v2, recent 2024‑2026 feature timeline, decision tree for empty widgets) that go beyond generic CloudWatch knowledge, but most of these facts are documented and a well‑trained model could retrieve them, so not a perfect 20.

dimensions.name: Mindset + Appropriate Procedures
dimensions.justification: Defines AWS‑specific procedures: pre‑check ordering, snapshot before put‑dashboard, mandatory CONFIRM gate, cross‑account role verification, metric‑math ID conventions, and region handling. Lacks a few minor procedural nuances (e.g., explicit pagination handling for list‑dashboards) preventing full marks.

dimensions.name: Anti-Pattern Quality
dimensions.justification: Contains a thorough NEVER list with concrete reasons (e.g., missing sharing role causes silent empty widgets, hard‑coding instance IDs breaks fleet changes). Lacks a few niche pitfalls such as region mismatches in widget properties and API throttling mitigation.

dimensions.name: Specification Compliance
dimensions.justification: Frontmatter is complete, description clearly states WHAT it does, WHEN to invoke, and includes a rich keyword list and activation triggers. Slight deduction for the 'invocation_schema' being a free‑form paragraph rather than a strict JSON schema.

dimensions.name: Progressive Disclosure
dimensions.justification: Information is layered: quick reference, mindset, pre‑flight, process, patterns, output contract, anti‑patterns. No overload at top level, but some sections (e.g., long expert heuristics) could be moved to references, so not perfect.

dimensions.name: Freedom Calibration
dimensions.justification: Destructive actions are tightly constrained (snapshot, CONFIRM gate, full pre‑checks) while creative dashboard design is left flexible. Minor deduction because the variable syntax ($INSTANCE_ID vs ${INSTANCE_ID}) is inconsistent, slightly loosening constraints.

dimensions.name: Pattern Recognition
dimensions.justification: Follows a recognizable pattern (overview, quick navigation, mindset, pre‑flight, process, patterns, output contract, anti‑patterns). Structure is coherent, only loses one point for occasional ad‑hoc formatting (tables mixed with free text).

dimensions.name: Practical Usability
dimensions.justification: Model outputs demonstrate the skill can be used end‑to‑end: correct VERDICT block, CONFIRM gate, full CLI command, and post‑verify steps. Small issues: variable syntax inconsistency ($INSTANCE_ID vs ${INSTANCE_ID}) and some pre‑check items omitted from the output (e.g., widget‑count check not listed), which could cause ambiguity in real use.
